International Cheese Federation: A Guide to Cheese Appreciation
This page presents a collection of blog posts from the International Cheese Federation, offering comprehensive guidance on understanding, selecting, storing, serving, and pairing various types of cheese. The articles aim to educate both culinary enthusiasts and industry professionals on appreciating cheese beyond conventional uses, covering common misconceptions, selection tips for different occasions, and pairing strategies with wine and everyday staples.

7 Cheeses Everyone Thinks They Know (But Don’t) 

 

Many cheeses have become global shorthand for a single taste, texture, or use. Names appear on menus, ingredient lists, and retail labels with the assumption that their meaning is settled. Beyond the Cheeseboard: Elevating Common Staples with Artisanal Cheese 

 

The appreciation of cheese is often compartmentalized into specific occasions, typically involving wine tastings or elaborate charcuterie boards. However, for industry professionals and culinary enthusiasts, understanding the versatility of cheese requires looking beyond traditional accompaniments. Cheese is a complex matrix of fats, proteins, acids, and fermentation byproducts that can interact dynamically with everyday pantry staples.…
